provenance.method: Single pinned logical CPU; resident buffers; 15 interleaved samples by default; calibration, CPU selection, file reads and allocations excluded. Every hash contributes to a checksum. Batch includes output stores and checksum reduction. Inline_fixed32 uses a literal 32-byte length, not a runtime length. Streaming reuses a state and updates in <=64 KiB chunks. SHA256_Init/Update/Final computes all 256 output bits; normal OpenSSL CPU dispatch retained. No filesystem-cold, graph-build, update, query, or multi-thread performance claim.
